title: Cloudflare Workers Free
description: Reach Workers and Queues on Cloudflare's free plan. R2 is treated as a separate opt-in product because enabling it uses Cloudflare's subscription/checkout flow even though it includes free monthly usage.

steps.title: Open Cloudflare Workers
steps.body: Control Walkthrough opens Workers & Pages directly. A Worker is a small program that runs on Cloudflare's network.
steps.humanGate: Login, passkey/MFA and CAPTCHA stay under your control.

steps.title: Stay on Workers Free unless you choose otherwise
steps.body: Workers has a free plan. Do not accept a paid upgrade, trial or billing change merely to continue this guide.

steps.title: Open Queues
steps.body: Queues is available on Workers Free. Control Walkthrough opens the Queues page directly instead of making you hunt through the mobile menu.

steps.title: R2 is optional and has a separate checkout
steps.body: R2 includes free monthly storage/operations, but Cloudflare requires an R2 subscription and checkout flow before you can use it. That may require a billing profile/payment method. Do not enter a card just because a walkthrough reached R2; only enable R2 when the project actually needs durable object storage and you intentionally accept that billing relationship.
steps.humanGate: Subscription checkout and payment-method entry are always your decision.

steps.title: Open R2 only if you intentionally need it
steps.body: This button only opens R2. If Cloudflare shows checkout or asks for a payment method, stop there unless you have deliberately decided to enable R2.
steps.humanGate: Control Walkthrough will not accept an R2 subscription or add billing details for you.
